description_text: Proposed procurement for NSN 5935016886896 CONNECTOR,PLUG,ELEC: Line 0001 Qty 44 UI EA Deliver To: By: 0049 DAYS ADO This Solicitation may result in an Automated IDC (Indefinite Delivery Contract). The term of the contract/order will be one year or until the aggregate total of orders placed against the contract/order reach 350000.00. The estimated number of orders per year is 4. The Guaranteed Minimum quantity will be 6. Items will be shipped to various CONUS and OCONUS (via consolidation and containerization point) DLA Depots. All responsible sources may submit a quote which, if timely received, shall be considered. Quotes must be submitted electronically.
